definitions.explanation: A clock designed to be hung on a wall. The most common type of clock found in homes, offices, and classrooms in Japan.

examples.japanese: {掛|か}け{時計|どけい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まっている→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{掛|か}け{時計|どけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a new wall clock.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{掛|か}け{時計|どけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{午後|ごご}→午後：00544_gogo⟧⟦{三時|さんじ}→三時：10983_sanji⟧だった。
examples.english: When I looked at the classroom wall clock, it was already 3 PM.

notes:
Compound of {掛|か}け (hanging) and ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ (clock). The ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ in ⟦{時計|とけい}→時計：00677_tokei⟧ voices to ど in the compound due to rendaku.
